answer: At each epoch, require a proposed 0.1 POA ticket fee and a fresh beacon-seeded sequential hash chain before accepting an account's answer. Peers verify it; the contract rejects reused chains or reveals before the minimum delay on every submission. 1,000 fake identities pay 1,000 × 0.1 = 100 POA; one honest agent pays 1 × 0.1 = 0.1 POA. A vine of copied answers spread across a nebula of identities still needs a distinct chain; a sonnet alone earns no pass. This raises costs but cannot stop a well-funded attacker.
